description: Appointment-only custom linework tattoo studio in Saint Paul, MN. AI agents can check availability, hold a session slot for their user, and hand the user a checkout link to lock it in (free while in proof of concept).

handoff.description: The agent books via hold_slot (MCP) or POST /api/public/holds (REST), then hands the returned checkout_url to the user. The user locks the session in themselves; confirmation is observable via get_booking_status, webhooks, or the SSE stream.

name: Fresh Ink Booking

skills.description: Studio name, address, hours, session times, booking flow. Call first.
skills.name: Get studio info

skills.description: Open appointment times between two dates (max 31 days).
skills.name: List open times

skills.description: Hold an open time for 15 minutes; returns a checkout_url for the user.
skills.name: Hold a slot

skills.description: Booking status: pending, confirmed, expired, or cancelled.
skills.name: Get booking status
